title: Titanium
description: This resource pack changes everything to do with Netherite into Titanium, complete with blocks, items, and achievements!
body:
![The Pack Name](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4291cbd95ca3fc1b85df2ff33b8d1e934d8661bc.png)
# **Description**
This pack adds Titanium, a substitute for Netherite, and aims to make it easier for players to find when mining in the nether. Packed with blocks, items and even advancements, this pack hopes to improve your minecraft experience for it's ease of use and new building opportunities!

## **Features**
- Titanium Armour Set
- Titanium Tool Set
- Block of Titanium
- Raw Titanium (Can be found in the nether)
- Titanium Chunk
- Titanium Ingot
- Runic Plate (Use on Diamond Armour in a smithing table to upgrade it into Titanium Armour)

## **Advancements**
> Ready For War: Obtain a full set of Titanium Armour

> SERIOUS Dedication: Obtain a Titanium Hoe

> A Stronger Upgrade: Obtain a piece of raw Titanium

Any issues or suggestions, message me on Discord!
